name: Tangrenshen Group Co., Ltd
summary: Tangrenshen Group Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sales of feed, live pigs, meat, and animal health products in China. It is also involved in pig breeding and fattening; pig, poultry, and duck farming; production and sale of edible vegetable oils; food and beverage services; aquatic feed production and sales; chain stores; production and sales of organic fertilizers and beneficial bacteria; veterinary drug business; feed trade; and bio- feed technology services; as well as trading, finance, quality inspection, and investment activities.
